news.headline: Accenture Up on Partnership with Anthropic; Novo Nordisk Falls on Turnaround | Stock Movers
news.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Novo Nordisk (NVO) shares are lower as it disappointed investors hoping for concrete turnaround plans from Chief Executive Officer Mike Doustdar after losing its lead in the obesity market to Eli Lilly & Co. The company pledged to launch more than five blockbusters and deliver more than $23 billion in new sales in coming years, but investors are selling shares due to lack of concrete news.
- Arhaus (ARHS) is moving after Jefferies upgraded the furniture company to buy from hold, writing that it has "newfound optimism on the retailer's strategy to elevate brand awareness" and improve market share.
- Accenture (ACN) is up on news Anthropic is partnering with Accenture to test the safety of its advanced artificial intelligence models by embedding evaluators from the consulting firm directly within its operations.

news.headline: Should You Pay Up For Tesla's Narrow Lead Over Its Peers?
news.summary: Tesla (TSLA) earns a better operating margin than General Motors and Sunrun, its two peers here, and trades at 310 times earnings, the highest of the three. General Motors' 37.8 times rests on trailing earnings that include a loss quarter, so it is not comparable to a clean year. The lead is real but narrow: it is a margin lead, and a thin one. The price rests on a robotaxi, robot, and chip build-out whose capital spending management expects to keep growing for two to three more years.

news.headline: Why the Best Price on Your Next Car Is Getting Harder to Find
news.summary: Stellantis will join other automakers who police advertised discounts, making it tricky to locate the lowest price.

news.headline: Why Is MercadoLibre (MELI) Raising $1 Billion In 2036 Notes?
news.summary: MercadoLibre (NasdaqGS:MELI) issued US$1b of senior unsecured notes maturing in 2036 to institutional buyers. The offering attracted demand from more than one hundred institutional investors, indicating broad appetite for the new debt. The new notes add long dated funding that can support MercadoLibre's liquidity profile and potential future investment plans.
